## Category 1: Database (4 tests)

### UAT-1.1: event_sub_rooms table exists
**Given:** Database migration applied
**Then:** `event_sub_rooms` table exists with columns: `id`, `event_id`, `session_id`, `initiator_id`, `target_id`, `status`, `created_at`
**Verify:** Supabase dashboard — check table structure

### UAT-1.2: Partial unique index prevents duplicate active sub-rooms
**Given:** Sub-room exists with status='pending' for target user Carol
**When:** Another user tries to create a sub-room targeting Carol
**Then:** DB constraint prevents creation (partial unique index on `event_id, target_id WHERE status IN ('pending', 'active')`)
**Verify:** Supabase dashboard — attempt insert, verify constraint error

### UAT-1.3: Sub-room status transitions correctly
**Given:** Sub-room created with status='pending'
**When:** Target joins → session completes → users leave
**Then:** Status transitions: pending → active → completed
**Verify:** Supabase dashboard — query sub-room row after each step

### UAT-1.4: RLS allows event participants to see sub-rooms
**Given:** Three users at an event: Alice (initiator), Bob (target), Carol (observer)
**Then:** All three can SELECT sub-rooms for that event. Only Alice can UPDATE (cancel) her initiated sub-room.
**Verify:** Supabase dashboard — test RLS as each user

---

## Category 2: UI — Room Lifecycle (4 tests)

### UAT-2.1: Sessions section hidden before event start
**Given:** Event with start time in the future
**When:** User views event page
**Then:** No "Sessions" section visible. Pure event info (location, RSVP, participants).
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — screenshot event page before start time

### UAT-2.2: Sessions section appears at event start
**Given:** Event start time has passed (or is now)
**When:** User views event page
**Then:** "Sessions" section visible below participant list with hint: "Tap someone to start a verification session"
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — screenshot event page at/after start time

### UAT-2.3: Participant list becomes tappable
**Given:** Event is live (past start time)
**When:** User views participant list
**Then:** Each participant row is tappable (cursor: pointer, hover state) except self
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — hover over participant, verify interactive state

### UAT-2.4: Room closes at event end
**Given:** Event end time has passed
**When:** User views event page
**Then:** Sessions section shows completed results (read-only). Cannot create new sub-rooms.
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — attempt to tap participant after event end, verify blocked

---

## Category 3: UI — Sub-Room Flow (5 tests)

### UAT-3.1: Tap participant shows confirmation dialog
**Given:** Event is live, user taps a participant
**When:** Confirmation dialog appears
**Then:** Shows "Start a session with [Name]?" with description and [Start session] / [Cancel] buttons
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — tap participant, screenshot dialog

### UAT-3.2: Initiator sees waiting state
**Given:** User taps [Start session]
**When:** Sub-room created
**Then:** Sessions section shows "You + [Name] · waiting for [Name]..." with [Cancel] option
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — screenshot sessions section after creation

### UAT-3.3: Target sees join invitation
**Given:** Sub-room created by another user targeting current user
**When:** Target views event page
**Then:** Sessions section shows "[Initiator] + You · [Join →]" button
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — view as target user, screenshot

### UAT-3.4: Others see active sub-room
**Given:** Sub-room exists between Alice and Bob
**When:** Carol (third party) views event page
**Then:** Sessions section shows "🔒 Alice + Bob · waiting" or "🔒 Alice + Bob · in session"
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — view as third user, screenshot

### UAT-3.5: Completed session shows verification status only
**Given:** Sub-room completed with verification
**When:** Any user views event page
**Then:** Sessions section shows "✓ Alice + Bob · verified" (no numeric score)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — complete a session, screenshot sessions section

---

## Category 4: Navigation (2 tests)

### UAT-4.1: Join navigates to /live with returnTo
**Given:** Sub-room exists, target taps [Join →]
**When:** Both users are navigated
**Then:** URL is `/live?code=SESSION_CODE&returnTo=/events/EVENT_SLUG`
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — tap Join, verify URL structure

### UAT-4.2: Back from /live returns to event page
**Given:** Users in /live session from event sub-room
**When:** Session ends and user taps "← Back to event"
**Then:** User navigates back to `/events/EVENT_SLUG`, sub-room shows as completed
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — complete session, tap back, verify URL and sessions section

---

## Category 5: Error Handling & Edge Cases (3 tests)

### UAT-5.1: Cannot tap yourself
**Given:** User views participant list
**Then:** Own entry is visually distinct (not tappable, different styling)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — verify own entry has no hover/tap behavior

### UAT-5.2: Cannot tap occupied participant
**Given:** Bob is currently in a session with Alice
**When:** Carol views participant list
**Then:** Bob is grayed out with "in session" indicator, not tappable
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — screenshot participant list showing occupied state

### UAT-5.3: Sub-room expires after 3 minutes
**Given:** Sub-room created, target never joins
**When:** 3 minutes pass
**Then:** Sub-room status changes to 'expired'. Initiator sees "Session expired". Target's [Join] button disappears.
**Verify:** DB query after 3 min wait, or set test timeout shorter for testing
